description: 50 pre-launch quality test cases for British English output (PRD §3.5.1). Run each through POST /api/generate and manually review for: British spelling (colour/organise/centre/travelling), British vocabulary (holiday/flat/postcode), DD/MM/YYYY dates, tone accuracy, recipient-appropriate greeting and sign-off, 150–250 word body, no invented facts (placeholders allowed). Pass threshold: ≥95% (at most 2 failures).
